nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: CALM DOWN! As much as I too wish that there are new more severe strains of Coronavirus or Influenza virus making their rounds...the rise in respiratory infections in China, Japan, parts of South America, Europe & South-East Asia are due to new genotypes of RSV virus & HMPV....

nodes.author: WeAreForked
nodes.text: @ThailandMedicaX Hmmm... you wish there are new, more severe strains of corona virus and flu?! What the hell? (Scratching head)

nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: H1N1 and H3N2 flu strains are also circulating and so are many new variants of SARS-CoV-2 such as LP.8.1, MC.10.1 etc but nothing really increased severity yet. But we do have an excellent condition for reassortant events invloving the H5N1 virus to occur! February is when the...

nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: 'lethal babies' are possibly going to emerge according to modeling platforms from 6 research centers. But remember, the new genotypes of RSV, HPMV, Adenovirus  etc are suffice to wreak havoc on a population that is already having immune issues! be patient, February is not to far!

nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: @NeherBirgitta I wanna know..I wanna know please...what new virus emerged..I checked with the Pasteur Institute in Shanghai as I have lots of friends there & also with the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Beijing but nothing extraordinary & as I had said its just HMPV & RSV but new genotypes

nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: @NeherBirgitta Maybe I missed something..but I have team scanning over GISAID sequence updates and checking on the various variant hunters etc but nothing concrete except for some old men speculating about flu strains..really nothing yet so far..even for H5n1..except for the Lousiana case..

nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: @NeherBirgitta But there has been a lot of cats dying form H5N1 in at least 6 states now in the U.S. and that is worrying!

nodes.author: NeherBirgitta
nodes.text: A twitter friend from California no longer lets his cat out. I have a cat whose saliva I am not allowed to come into contact with.  According to reports, H1N1 seems to be a major problem in Japan at the moment. It is exciting how little we know about viruses and yet they are being played with in laboratories.
